translations.web: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;
translations.bsb: You are not to do as we are doing here today, where everyone does what seems right in his own eyes.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
